sections.title: Hyrule
sections.note: From the Captain's sword to Yuga at Hyrule Castle: three Pendants and the Master Sword.

items.name: Deliver the Captain's sword
items.howTo: Wake in Link's House and follow Gulley to the Blacksmith's Forge to the west, where the Captain has left his sword. The guard at Hyrule Castle sends you on to the Sanctuary. It is locked, so take Dampé's secret passage under the bushy grave in the Graveyard to the east; the Lamp is in its first chest. Inside, Yuga turns Seres into a painting.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon calls the sword the Captain's Sword, Zelda Wiki the Forgotten Sword. Link keeps it.

items.name: Warn Princess Zelda
items.howTo: Link wakes back home, where Ravio moves in and lends him his bracelet. Go to Hyrule Castle; Impa lets you in to see Zelda, who gives you a charm, the Pendant of Courage, and sends you to Sahasrahla.
items.notes: The charm is only named the Pendant of Courage later, when Sahasrahla explains the three Pendants after the Eastern Palace. Ravio's Bracelet comes first, from Ravio at Link's House.

items.name: Visit Sahasrahla
items.howTo: Sahasrahla tells you his pupil Osfala, a descendant of the Seven Sages, is near the Eastern Palace. At the Eastern Ruins you find pillars marked with a Bow and Ravio's signs; go home, tell Ravio you saw the Bow and he lends it to you free.
items.notes: Zelda Wiki: the free loan is taken back if you fall in battle, like any rental.

items.name: Eastern Palace (Yuga)
items.howTo: In the east of Hyrule. Shoot the two crystal switches by the Bow pillars to open the way, then follow Osfala into the palace. Yuga paints Osfala; beat Yuga with arrows and sword. He turns Link into a painting too, and Ravio's Bracelet lets Link step out: from now on Link can Wall Merge.
items.notes: No Pendant and no big-chest item here (the big chest holds the Big Key). Afterwards Sahasrahla explains the three Pendants and Yuga seals Hyrule Castle in a barrier.

items.name: Return Queen Oren's Smooth Gem
items.howTo: At the bridge east of Link's House, Irene gives you the Bell. In Zora's Domain (far north-east) the Shady Guy has stolen Queen Oren's Smooth Gem. Scare him in Kakariko by stepping out of the wall behind him: he gives you the Pegasus Boots. Buy the gem from the Street Merchant for 200 Rupees and drop it in Oren's pool.
items.notes: Ravio's Shop opens around here: Zelda Wiki says once the Smooth Gem is returned, Zelda Dungeon once you have the Flippers or have taken the Power Glove into the Death Mountain cave. Rent the Tornado Rod for the House of Gales and the Hammer for the Tower of Hera.

items.name: House of Gales (Margomill)
items.howTo: On the island in Lake Hylia, south-east of Link's House. Swim there with Zora's Flippers and use the Tornado Rod (rented from Ravio) on the floor switch at the door. The Tornado Rod is needed throughout.
items.notes: No treasure item. Can be done before or after the Tower of Hera.

items.name: Get Rosso's Power Glove
items.howTo: Talk to Rosso twice at his house, north-west of the Sanctuary below Death Mountain. Lift the rocks blocking the cave one screen south to start up Death Mountain.
items.notes: Pick up every rock round his house and Rosso gives a chest of 50 Rupees (Zelda Wiki).

items.name: Tower of Hera (Moldorm)
items.howTo: Climb Death Mountain through the boulder caves with the Power Glove and pound the stakes at the tower's door with the Hammer (rented from Ravio). The Hammer is needed throughout.
items.notes: No treasure item. Can be done before or after the House of Gales.

items.name: Draw the Master Sword
items.howTo: With all three Pendants, enter the Lost Woods north of Kakariko Village and follow the Poes' directions three times (one Poe, then two, then three) to the Master Sword. A wrong turn sends you back with fewer Poes to follow.
items.notes: Hint Ghosts (seen through the Hint Glasses) point the way for a Play Coin. Ravio also starts selling his items once you have the three Pendants.

items.name: Hyrule Castle (Yuga)
items.howTo: Cut the barrier at the gate with the Master Sword, leave the castle by the second floor and climb the tower to the eighth floor. Yuga splits into three; find the real one. Then cut the curtain at the top, Wall Merge through the crack behind it and follow Yuga into Lorule.
items.notes: Yuga gives no Heart Container here (Zelda Wiki). Link wakes in Lorule's Blacksmith's Forge, and Fissures to Lorule now appear all over Hyrule.

sections.title: Lorule
sections.note: Seven Sages in any order (the Desert Palace after the Thieves' Hideout), then Lorule Castle.

items.name: Thieves' Hideout (Stalblind)
items.howTo: At the north end of Thieves' Town, west of Lorule's Blacksmith's Forge. Finish the thieves' password song at the door: "a narrow path", "really despair", "to thievin'!" (the townsfolk hint at the words). Inside, free the Thief Girl and lead her out.
items.notes: Treasure: Master Ore. Needs no item from Ravio (Zelda Wiki). Afterwards Osfala hands over the Sand Rod he rented, Sheerow takes it back, and Ravio's Shop stocks it.

items.name: Desert Palace (Zaganaga)
items.area: Desert Palace (Hyrule's desert; boss in Misery Mire)
items.howTo: Get the Sand Rod from Ravio. The desert is walled off, so take the Fissure in the small area between the Southern Ruins and the desert into Misery Mire, come back through the Fissure north of its Weather Vane and cross the desert on Sand Rod pillars and more Fissures to the palace. The boss arena is in Misery Mire, through a Fissure past the Big Key door.
items.notes: Treasure: Titan's Mitt. Needs: Sand Rod. The one Sage dungeon standing in Hyrule, and the only Lorule-phase dungeon with a fixed prerequisite.

items.name: Dark Palace (Gemesaur King)
items.howTo: From the Eastern Palace go one screen south and bomb the boulder on the west side to uncover a Fissure. In Lorule, Wall Merge past the guards' lines of sight through the maze (if caught, you're jailed and escape by Wall Merging) and bomb open the palace entrance.
items.notes: Treasure: Master Ore. Needs: Bombs. The guards leave once the palace is cleared.

items.name: Swamp Palace (Arrghus)
items.howTo: Pay the Bomb-Shop Man south-west of Lorule's Blacksmith's Forge 200 Rupees for the Big Bomb Flower. Blow up the boulder just south of the shop, then lead another flower (an enemy hit sets it off) to the boulder at the palace, south of the Vacant House, to drain the moat. Hookshot to the pegs at the door.
items.notes: Treasure: Blue Mail. Needs: Hookshot, Big Bomb Flower (200 Rupees, paid once).

items.name: Skull Woods (Knucklemaster)
items.howTo: Take the Fissure on the back of Sahasrahla's house in Kakariko, go north-east and into the woods by their south-eastern entrance. The dungeon is entered and left by several holes and doors in the woods above.
items.notes: Treasure: Master Ore. Needs no item from Ravio (Zelda Wiki).

items.name: Turtle Rock (Grinexx)
items.howTo: South of the log to the House of Gales, Wall Merge along the south wall to a Fissure into Lorule Lake. Return Mama Turtle's three babies (one on land to the west, one beset by enemies in the north-west, one pushed off a ledge from the wall in the north-west); she carries you to the dungeon. Freeze the lava at the door with the Ice Rod.
items.notes: Treasure: Hylian Shield. Needs: Ice Rod, Zora's Flippers.

items.name: Ice Ruins (Dharkstare)
items.howTo: Hookshot over the broken bridge east of the Tower of Hera and ride the moving platforms through the lava cave to Rosso's Ore Mine. Take the Fissure to Lorule, climb the ice cave east of it and burn the big Ice Gimos blocking the door with the Fire Rod.
items.notes: Treasure: Stamina Scroll. Needs: Fire Rod, Hookshot (and the Power Glove for Death Mountain).

items.name: Receive the Triforce of Courage
items.howTo: Rescue all seven Sages. After the seventh, they grant Link the Triforce of Courage, which he needs to get into Lorule Castle.
items.notes: Zelda Wiki leaves the chamber unnamed in this game; Zelda Wiki's Triforce page calls it the Temple of Light.

items.name: Lorule Castle
items.howTo: North of the Vacant House in the middle of Lorule. Hilda breaks the barrier for you. Clear the castle's four trial rooms to open the door to the throne room.
items.notes: Treasure: Red Mail. No Heart Container. Zelda Wiki counts the throne room as a separate dungeon.

items.name: Yuga Ganon
items.howTo: Hilda takes Zelda's Triforce of Wisdom and sets Yuga Ganon on Link. When Yuga absorbs Hilda and retreats into the walls, Zelda's painting gives Link the Bow of Light: Wall Merge and shoot him in the back to knock him out, then use the sword.
items.notes: Return his energy balls with the sword (or the Bug-Catching Net) in the rallies between phases. Zelda Wiki: the name Yuga Ganon is from Prima's guide; the game says Yuga or the Demon King.

items.name: Hilda, Ravio and the Triforce
items.area: Sacred Realms of Lorule and Hyrule
items.howTo: After the fight Ravio stops Hilda from taking Link's Triforce, and she sends Link and Zelda home. In Hyrule's Sacred Realm they wish on the Triforce to give Lorule back its own. Then the credits.
items.notes: Clearing the game unlocks Hero Mode for new files (Zelda Wiki).
